neighbours.label: The word right before a precious shared thing we must care for is named ('our' before children, youth or planet; 'your' before loved ones; 'on' before Earth), in a protecting, caring or nurturing frame; also 'on' in 'back on Earth' after talk of space. Quiet on the same words in everyday frames (fixing our roof, files on the desk). English only.
neighbours.short: slot before a cherished shared thing (our children, life on Earth)
fire: We have a duty to protect our children from harm and give them a safe place to grow.
Investing in our youth today is how we nurture the leaders of tomorrow.
Every small choice matters when it comes to saving our planet for future generations.
Take a moment tonight to tell your loved ones how much you care about them.
We must cherish and protect life on Earth, because there is no other home like it.
After six months on the space station, the astronaut said it felt wonderful to be back on Earth.
Please keep your loved ones safe and check in on them during the storm.
It is our responsibility to care for our planet and leave it healthier than we found it.
quiet: We have a duty to fix our roof before the rain season starts next month.
Updating our software today is how we avoid crashes tomorrow.
Every small choice matters when it comes to planning our budget for next year.
Take a moment tonight to tell your landlord about the leaking faucet.
Please leave the files on the desk so I can sign them in the morning.
After six months of renovations, the family said it felt wonderful to be back in the kitchen.
Please keep your receipts safe and file them during tax season.
It is our responsibility to clean our garage and leave it tidier than we found it.

predictions: Blind test written by a label-only author. Expect most fire items to clear 0.20; risk: bare 'protect our' scored ~0.2 in probes, and 'your' before loved ones was weak (~0.14).
